entrada.titulo: Enhancing anomaly detection and prevention in Internet of Things (IoT) using deep neural networks and blockchain based cyber security

perfil_anterior.problema: unauthorized access, malware assaults, and data breaches
perfil_anterior.solucao: blockchain-based architecture and integrated DNN to ensure data integrity, enhance anomaly detection, and offer IoT networks autonomous, distributed threat-mitigating properties
perfil_anterior.limites: weaknesses in smart contracts, Sybil attacks, and 51% assaults may still penetrate blockchain-based security procedures
perfil_anterior.possibilidades: Explorar consenso leve (PoA, DAG) em ambientes de borda para reduzir ainda mais a latência; integrar verifiable credentials para gerenciamento de identidade e revogação de dispositivos IoT; aplicar quantização e poda de modelos DNN para diminuição da carga computacional nos nós de borda; investigar aprendizado federado para treinamento distribuído sem exposição de dados sensíveis; avaliar a robustez contra ataques adversariais usando técnicas de defesa avançadas; testar estratégias de batch e compressão de logs para minimizar o crescimento da blockchain em cenários de cidades inteligentes.

Incorporating parallel distributed system performance pdse [d − qa′′], dynamic load adaptability 
[yt − uj′′], and blockchain-supported balanced workloads Bsw [oi − sn′′] , the equation represents the 
evaluation of scalability ( S). The method improves the system’ s scalability by using decentralized computing

The method significantly lowers single points of failure by using a decentralization score of 97.33%, enhancing 
IoT network security (Fig. 10). While the Blockchain-integrated solution ensures distributed, tamper-proof data 
storage and authentication, conventional centralized security systems are open to deliberate access. Every IoT 
device logs activities on a private Blockchain, ensuring trust and preventing illicit alterations. This significant 
degree of decentralization guarantees its self-sustaining character and strengthens the IoT ecosystem by 
improving resilience against cyberattacks, openness, and security.

By combining blockchain-supported processes ( Bs [w − uy′′]) and unified self-governing systems 
(Ua [w − sy′′]), the Eq.  25 stands for the analysis of decentralization ( D) and the reduction of centralized 
control factors (hf s′′). The method uses blockchain technology and autonomous decision-making systems to 
bolster decentralization, as shown in Table 3.
The hybrid DNN-Blockchain architecture for IoT network security is presented in this study. Blockchain 
guarantees automatic threat reaction and tamper-proof security; the DNN detects abnormalities with 99.18% 
accuracy. The system has tremendous scalability—94.96%, responds rapidly (95.25%), decentralizes (97.33%), 
and reduces false positives (15.42%). Results show how well IoT ecosystems are locked by artificial intelligence-
blockchain synergy, as shown in Table 3 and Fig. 11.
A comprehensive computational cost analysis for DNN training and blockchain operations is necessary to 
guarantee that the DNNs-BCT system is feasible for real-world deployment, especially in IoT contexts with 
limited resources. T o decrease inference delay and energy consumption, optimization methods like pruned 
architectures, quantization, or knowledge distillation may be necessary for DNN models, which are useful for 
anomaly detection but computationally costly. When assessing the training phase, it is important to consider 
the memory footprint, processing time, and GPU/TPU needs to guarantee scalability. The blockchain adds 
processing costs with transaction verification, block production, and consensus procedures. Although blockchain

resposta.resumo: O estudo apresenta uma arquitetura híbrida DNN‑Blockchain para segurança de redes IoT, destacando alta escalabilidade (94,96%), rapidez (95,25%) e descentralização (97,33%). Cada dispositivo registra atividades em uma blockchain privada, reduzindo pontos únicos de falha. Embora a detecção de anomalias alcance 99,18% de acurácia, os autores apontam a necessidade de análise de custo computacional e otimizações para dispositivos com recursos limitados.

resposta.interpretacao: Os autores demonstram que a combinação de DNN e blockchain pode oferecer alta escalabilidade e descentralização para IoT, mitigando pontos únicos de falha. Contudo, reconhecem que o custo computacional da treinamento e das operações blockchain pode ser um obstáculo para dispositivos de recursos limitados, exigindo otimizações de modelo e análise de viabilidade prática.
